target_effects.rationale: A replaces xs by its sorted copy.

upstream.rationale: fn_0 inserts every element in order, so under pre the state entering A is already sorted.

observers.rationale: Channel 0 folds for the minimum when use_left, otherwise reads the head.
Channel 1 folds for the maximum when use_right, otherwise reads the tail.

mask_guard.expr: pre or ((use_left or xs[0] == min(xs)) and (use_right or xs[-1] == max(xs)))
mask_guard.rationale: Upstream fixed point under pre, otherwise both observer conditions must hold.
